name: MediaRecorder
role: Real-time recording of a MediaStream to WebM/MP4; wall-clock bound, not frame-exact
summary: Records a MediaStream (canvas.captureStream, tab or microphone) into a Blob in the browser's chosen codec. It runs in real time and drops or duplicates frames when rendering is slow, so output depends on wall-clock timing, not on t. Fine for a quick preview or live capture; wrong for frame-accurate renders where frames are produced in any order.
use_when: A quick real-time preview recording of a canvas scene
Capturing microphone or tab audio you cannot render offline
avoid_when: Deterministic or frame-exact output: WebCodecs, or Playwright screenshots into ffmpeg
Seeking frames in any order: capture per frame and encode with ffmpeg
Controlled codec, bitrate and keyframes: WebCodecs
Offline generated audio: Web Audio's OfflineAudioContext
notes: 2026-10-26: Container and codec support in headless Chromium not checked; call MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported at runtime.

assessment.rationale: Chrome 47+ and widely available per MDN, but real-time only. WebCodecs plus ffmpeg cover VCR's deterministic capture with more control, so incremental value is low.
